answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy must be priced, not policed. Every identity stakes earned POA and faces a fresh challenge whose seed words stay sealed until the epoch opens, so a clone farm pays one genuine generation per clone per epoch. Verification acts as a jetty: only countersigned balances cross into finality. Standing is the canyon wall that narrows entry, since jurors who vouch for junk lose stake and voice. No pearl of reputation can be cloned cheaply, and faking an identity must cost more than the reward it farms.
